exceptions.reason: Only the 9B transformer is packed; the 8B Qwen3 text encoder ships dense bf16 in every tier (sc-8711). The worker forces the load quant to None so it is never re-quantized — declared as mlx.denseTextEncoderTier.

exceptions.note: ~16 GB is descriptive prose, not a measurement: all three klein tier footprints carry null residentMemoryBytes. On the candle lane the same encoder runs F32 (~32 GB), so the cost is lane-dependent and needs measuring per lane.

exceptions.reason: The InstantID IdentityNet ControlNet, the ip-adapter, and the antelopev2 face pack stay dense because Q4/Q8 measurably drop ArcFace identity fidelity — the whole point of the route.
exceptions.source: config/manifests/builtin.models.jsonc `instantid_realvisxl` — "The InstantID IdentityNet ControlNet + ip-adapter (~4 GiB) + antelopev2 face pack stay DENSE (small, precision-sensitive)"
exceptions.note: This entry additionally DEFAULTS to bf16 for the whole model for the same reason, so on a default job nothing is above tier; the exception applies when a user explicitly selects q4/q8.

exceptions.reason: The SDXL-style UNet and the ChatGLM3-6B encoder are packed; the SDXL VAE stays dense f32 in every tier (fp16/int8-unstable).
exceptions.source: crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-kolors/src/pipeline.rs — "the VAE stays dense f32 in every tier (the MLX packer mirrors it, not packs it)"

exceptions.reason: Packing the pose-control branch to q4 measures "pose-locked; non-pose details drift" — the control residual is precision-sensitive (RMS-clamped at τ) and is the thing the user actually asked for, so a q4 base floors its branch at q8 instead of following the tier down.
exceptions.source: config/manifests/builtin.models.jsonc `candle.control.branchPackSaveGb` (q8 −8.4, q4 −10.2 GB; the floor forgoes the 1.8 GB difference)
exceptions.note: The q8 case is NOT an exception: on a q8 base the branch follows the tier exactly, which is why sc-15799 deleted the branch-quant lever outright rather than keeping its q8 rung.

exceptions.source: crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-lens/src/quant.rs — "The VAE is the shared Flux.2 decoder and is never quantized (runs f32)"

exceptions.reason: The gpt-oss-20b MoE text encoder ships MXFP4 on disk and MLX has no mxfp4 compute path, so it is upcast to bf16 at load. No repackaging fixes this; it needs an mxfp4 compute path or a different published dtype.
exceptions.source: crates/sceneworks-worker/src/mlx_fit_gate.rs — the HEADROOM_GB calibration table (sc-10863): lens-turbo bf16 measures 28.43 GiB on disk / 45.67 GiB resident / 75.55 GiB peak; the 17.24 GiB in-memory weight expansion is resident − disk (1.61x).
exceptions.note: The bf16 tier is NOT above tier (bf16 is what the user selected), which is why appliesToTiers excludes it — but the 17.24 GiB was measured there, and it is the same upcast on every tier. The separate 29.88 GiB activation transient is not a residency exception and is out of scope for this ledger.

An 8-bit FLOOR on the Qwen3-VL LM's 36 decoder layers: a q4 request is silently raised to 8 bits for them, so the q4 tier shares q8's decoder layers and differs only in the token embedding and the vision tower.
exceptions.source: crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-mage/src/quant.rs `LM_LAYER_MIN_BITS = 8`; the cost is recorded in mlx-gen-mage/src/memory.rs (q4 calibration peak 5.940 → 7.868 GB, of which the LM's 36 layers at 8 bits are ~1.9 GB) and in the manifest's per-tier TE footprints (q4 4.331 vs q8 4.731 GB on disk).

exceptions.reason: An 8-bit floor on the DiT's `norm_out.linear` (the final modulation projection), which q4 cannot serve without visible degradation.
exceptions.source: crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-mage/src/quant.rs `FINAL_MOD_MIN_BITS = 8`; the manifest's per-tier DiT footprints record q4 2.317 → 2.326 GB.
